name: Fungalmancer Flurgl
guide_text: Flurgl is best in an economy-centric lobby, because the hero power benefits from cycling cards. Even though you're a Murloc hero, pirate or elemental cycle comps utilizing [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] can make a ton of use out of your hero power.
buddy_guide_text: Target as many 5 drops as possible to get [[Primalfin Lookout||60028]] and [[Mrglin' Burglar]] if you're playing Murlocs.
